skin.overview: A pore becomes a pimple when four things line up: sebum runs high, the pore lining sheds faster than it clears and forms a plug, bacteria multiply in the trapped oil, and the whole thing inflames. Topical products act on the last two. The first two are set upstream, by insulin and IGF-1, by how much inflammatory load the gut is passing on, and by cortisol at night. That is why clearing the surface alone usually buys a few good weeks and then the same spots return. The four steps below run in that order on purpose: take the load off, make what you take in actually count, supply the materials repair needs, then protect the result.
skin.overviewZh: 一个毛孔变成一颗痘，要四件事同时凑齐：油脂分泌偏高，毛孔内壁角质脱落快过排出、堵成栓子，细菌在闷住的油脂里大量繁殖，然后整个发炎。外用产品处理的是后两件。前两件是被上游决定的，决定它的是胰岛素和IGF-1、肠道往全身送出多少炎症负担、以及夜里的皮质醇。这就是为什么只清表面，通常能换来几周好转，然后同样的位置又回来。下面四步是有顺序的：先卸掉负担，再让吃进去的真的算数，然后把修复原料补上，最后守住结果。

rows.why: Start here because this is the best-evidenced diet link in acne. A high-glycemic meal spikes insulin, insulin raises IGF-1, and IGF-1 does two things at once: it tells sebaceous cells to make more oil, and it raises inflammatory signalling inside those same cells. In trials, two weeks of a low-glycemic-load diet measurably dropped IGF-1, and twelve weeks dropped lesion counts. You do not have to quit rice. You have to stop the spike: slow the starch, add fibre alongside it, and put protein where a refined-carb breakfast used to be.
rows.whyZh: 从这里开始，因为这是痘痘领域证据最强的一条饮食链。一顿高升糖的饭把胰岛素顶上去，胰岛素抬高IGF-1，而IGF-1同时做两件事：让皮脂腺细胞多产油，并且提高这些细胞内部的炎症信号。临床试验里，低升糖负荷饮食两周就能实测降低IGF-1，十二周降低痘的数量。你不需要戒掉米饭，你需要的是掐掉那个尖峰：把淀粉的分解放慢，同一餐配上纤维，再把原来那份精致碳水早餐换成蛋白质。

rows.why: The second load is the gut. When the gut ecology tips, barrier permeability rises and metabolites that should have left the body get through instead, which raises inflammation everywhere, skin included. There is a second cost people miss: the same dysbiosis impairs absorption of zinc, selenium and omega-3, which are exactly the nutrients the repair stage depends on. So this is not only about clearing, it decides whether step three will work at all. Fibre carries out, probiotics rebuild, and the liver handles what the gut passes on.
rows.whyZh: 第二个负担在肠道。肠道生态一旦失衡，肠壁通透性升高，本该排出体外的代谢物反而穿过屏障进入循环，全身的炎症水平随之上升，皮肤也在其中。还有一笔很多人漏掉的代价：同样的菌群失衡会损害锌、硒和Omega-3的吸收，而这几样恰恰是后面「补」那一步要用的原料。所以这一步不只是清，它决定了第三步能不能生效。纤维负责带走，益生菌负责重建，肝脏处理肠道递上来的那一部分。

products: Artistry Studio Rose All Day Anti-Acne Toner
rows.why: External clearing deals with the plug that is already in the pore. The reason salicylic acid is the standard here and not something that sounds stronger: it is oil-soluble, so it can travel through the sebum filling the pore and break the plug up from the inside. A water-soluble acid stays on the surface and never reaches it. Use the toner across the whole face rather than only on the spot you can see, because the pore that becomes next week's pimple is already clogged today. Once a week is enough for the mask; over-cleansing raises oil output.
rows.whyZh: 外清处理的是已经堵在毛孔里的那个栓子。水杨酸之所以是这里的标准配置，而不是某个听起来更猛的成分，原因很具体：它是脂溶性的，能穿过填满毛孔的油脂，从内部把栓子瓦解掉。水溶性的酸只停在表面，根本到不了那里。爽肤水要全脸用，而不是只点你看得见的那颗，因为下周会冒出来的那个毛孔，今天已经堵上了。面膜每周一次足够，过度清洁反而会让出油更多。

rows.why: This stage is about conversion rate. Swallowing zinc, vitamin C and B vitamins is not the same as absorbing them, and poorly digested food left sitting in the gut adds back to the load you just spent step one reducing. For anyone who eats out most days or bloats after a big meal, skipping this step is why the supplements in step three underperform. The 6-in-1 folds clearing and regulating into one drink if you would rather not manage four bottles.
rows.whyZh: 这一步管的是转化率。把锌、维生素C和B族吞下去，跟真正吸收进去是两件事；而消化不完全、滞留在肠道里的食物残渣，又会把你第一步刚卸掉的负担加回来。对于经常在外面吃、或者大餐后腹胀的人，跳过这一步，就是第三步的营养素效果打折的原因。如果不想同时管三四瓶，六合一把清和调压进一杯里。

rows.why: A patch is not clearing anything, it is regulating how one lesion heals, which is why it sits here rather than in step one. It seals the spot into a moist, closed environment, keeps outside bacteria and air oxidation off an open surface, and physically stops you touching it. That last part matters most: picking is the single biggest cause of the mark left behind, and a mark outlasts the pimple by months. In a controlled trial, patched lesions scored better on crusting, redness, size and elevation. The spot gel is for the one that has not opened yet.
rows.whyZh: 痘痘贴不是在清理什么，它调控的是一颗痘的愈合环境，所以它放在这一步而不是第一步。它把这颗痘封成一个湿润的闭合环境，隔绝外界细菌和空气氧化，并且在物理上让你碰不到它。最后这一点最关键：抠，是留下痘印的头号原因，而痘印比痘本身要多留好几个月。在对照试验里，贴过的痘在结痂、泛红、大小和凸起这几项上评分都更好。凝胶留给还没破的那一颗。

products: Artistry Studio Glow Boss Cleanser + Exfoliator
rows.why: Cleansing is where most people make things worse without knowing. Harsh surfactants strip the barrier lipids, the skin reads that as damage, and sebum output goes up to compensate. So the person who washes four times a day to control oil ends up producing more of it. A mousse dilutes and distributes the surfactant before it reaches your face, which is the whole point of the format. Daily gentle exfoliation beats aggressive weekly scrubbing; pick the exfoliating one only if your skin is genuinely congested.
rows.whyZh: 洗脸是多数人不知不觉把事情弄糟的地方。清洁力过强的表面活性剂会把屏障脂质剥掉，皮肤把这个读成损伤，于是提高皮脂分泌来补偿。结果就是：一天洗四次脸想控油的人，最后出油更多。慕斯剂型在接触皮肤之前就把表面活性剂稀释并分散开，这就是这个剂型存在的意义。每天温和去角质好过每周一次猛搓；只有在皮肤确实堵得厉害时，才选带磨砂的那一支。

rows.why: If the breakouts sit on the nose folds, the T-zone and the chin, that is the classic B2 pattern. B2 maintains sebaceous gland and follicle function; without it sebum regulation drifts, pores clog and inflame. B3 belongs to the same story from the other end, and its shortfall shows up as the rough little bumps on the backs of the arms and along the jaw. B vitamins are water-soluble and clear in roughly a day, so they only work daily. Late nights burn B2 faster, which is why the nose goes first after a bad week.
rows.whyZh: 如果痘集中在鼻唇沟、三角区和下巴，这是B2的典型分布。B2维护皮脂腺和毛囊的功能，缺了它，油脂分泌就会失调、毛孔堵塞、随即发炎。B3从另一头讲的是同一件事，它的不足表现为上臂外侧和下颌线上那些粗糙的小疙瘩。B族是水溶性的，大约一天就清空，所以它只有天天吃才有意义。熬夜会加速B2消耗，这就是为什么熬了糟糕的一周之后，先冒出来的往往是鼻子旁边那颗。

rows.why: These two are one job: rebuilding. Skin turns over every day, and without enough protein the old cells shed but the new ones cannot be built. Vitamin C is the cofactor the body needs to actually assemble that protein into collagen, which is what decides whether a pitted mark fills back in. Vitamin C has a second, separate action: it inhibits tyrosinase, so it slows new pigment forming. Read that carefully, it keeps marks from getting darker rather than bleaching the ones you already have, which is why it only pays off as a daily habit.
rows.whyZh: 这两样其实是同一件事：重建。皮肤每天都在更新，蛋白质不够，旧细胞脱落了，新细胞造不出来。而维生素C是身体把这些蛋白质真正组装成胶原蛋白所需的辅因子，痘坑能不能填回来，取决于这一步。维生素C还有第二个独立作用：抑制酪氨酸酶，从源头减缓新色素的生成。这句话要读仔细，它管的是让痘印不再变深，而不是把已有的印漂掉，所以它只有当成每日习惯才划算。

products: Artistry Vitamin C + HA3 Daily Serum
rows.why: Oral and topical vitamin C are not interchangeable, which is why this sits beside the tablet rather than instead of it. Swallowed vitamin C is distributed by the bloodstream and reaches the outer skin layers poorly; applied vitamin C lands directly where the pigment is being made. Use them together and you are working the same tyrosinase step from both sides. The three hyaluronic acid weights are the second half of the bottle: large molecules hold water at the surface, smaller ones carry it deeper, and hydrated skin produces less oil, not more.
rows.whyZh: 口服维C和外用维C不能互相替代，所以这一条是放在药片旁边，而不是取而代之。吞下去的维C靠血液分配，到达皮肤外层的量很有限；涂上去的维C则直接落在色素正在生成的地方。两者一起用，等于从内外两侧作用在同一个酪氨酸酶环节上。三种分子量的玻尿酸是这瓶里的另一半：大分子在表层锁水，小分子往深处带，而水分充足的皮肤出油会更少，不是更多。

rows.why: This is the most specific mechanism on the page, and the one almost nobody explains. Acne skin produces roughly twice as much squalene as clear skin. Squalene itself is harmless; oxidised squalene is not, and its peroxide by-products are directly comedogenic and inflammatory. Measurements in acne patients show exactly that pattern: squalene peroxides up in the sebum, vitamin E and vitamin A down in the plasma. Vitamin E is the fat-phase antioxidant that sits inside that oil and stops the peroxidation. The lecithin alongside it is the same phospholipid your cell membranes are built from: an intact membrane holds water in and the cell stays a grape, a damaged one leaks and it becomes a raisin. That is also why topical moisturiser alone only goes so far.
rows.whyZh: 这是整页里最具体的一条机制，也是几乎没人讲清楚的一条。痘痘肌分泌的角鲨烯大约是健康皮肤的两倍。角鲨烯本身无害，但氧化后的角鲨烯不是，它的过氧化产物直接具有致粉刺性和促炎性。在痘痘患者身上实测到的正是这个组合：皮脂里角鲨烯过氧化物升高，血浆里维生素E和维生素A降低。维生素E是驻守在油脂相里的抗氧化剂，它的位置就在那层油里，作用就是阻止这个氧化过程。同时配的卵磷脂，与细胞膜的磷脂成分相同：膜完整，水分锁得住，细胞是饱满的葡萄；膜破损，水从里面跑掉，就成了葡萄干。这也解释了为什么只靠外用保湿，效果总是有限。

rows.why: Omega-3 works on two of the four steps at once: it slows the hyperkeratinisation that forms the plug, and it lowers leukotriene B4, one of the signals that turns a clogged pore into an inflamed one. The reason this is almost always a real gap is the ratio, not the absence: modern diets carry plenty of omega-6 and very little omega-3, and the balance between them is what sets the inflammatory tone. If you rarely eat oily fish, assume the gap is there.
rows.whyZh: Omega-3 同时作用在四步中的两步：它减缓形成栓子的角化过度，并且降低白三烯B4，那是把一个堵住的毛孔推向发炎的信号之一。这一项之所以几乎总是真实存在的缺口，问题不在于完全没有，而在于比例：现代饮食里Omega-6很多、Omega-3很少，而决定炎症基调的正是两者的比例。如果你很少吃深海鱼，就默认这个缺口存在。

rows.why: Both of these show up as measured shortfalls rather than theory. Serum zinc runs lower in people with acne than in controls, and lowest in the most severe grades; trials adding zinc report fewer inflammatory lesions. Vitamin D follows the same shape: deficiency is roughly twice as common in acne patients as in matched controls, and levels track inversely with severity. Neither is a treatment. Both are worth closing if the gap is yours, and vitamin D is one of the few things here a blood panel can actually tell you about.
rows.whyZh: 这两样都是实测出来的缺口，不是推论。痘痘人群的血清锌水平低于对照组，而且分级越重的人越低；补锌的试验报告炎症性皮损减少。维生素D是同样的形状：痘痘人群的缺乏率大约是对照组的两倍，血清水平与严重程度呈负相关。两者都不是治疗手段。但如果这个缺口在你身上，就值得补上；而且维生素D是这一页里少数几个抽血就能看清楚的指标之一。

rows.why: Two supporting lines. Plant antioxidants work in the water phase where vitamin E works in the oil phase, and the carotenoid families are also where the body sources vitamin A, the other nutrient measured low in acne plasma. Calcium and magnesium are here for a different reason: they maintain neuromuscular excitability, and when they are short the body will not release even after you lie down. Across the 72 client assessments we have on file, 77% of acne cases also reported chronic late nights, and skin repair happens overnight.
rows.whyZh: 两条辅助线。植物抗氧化物工作在水相，而维生素E工作在油相，两者互补；而类胡萝卜素家族同时也是身体获取维生素A的来源，那是痘痘人群血浆里另一个被测出偏低的营养素。钙镁放在这里是另一个理由：它们维持神经肌肉的兴奋性，缺的时候人躺下了也放松不下来。在我们手上的72份健康评估里，77%的痘痘案例同时存在长期晚睡，而皮肤的修复发生在夜里。

rows.why: Sunscreen is usually sold to acne-prone skin as mark protection, and that undersells it. UV generates reactive oxygen species in the skin, and those are what oxidise the squalene in your sebum into the comedogenic by-products from the replenish stage. So this step is not only protecting the result, it is cutting off one of the sources upstream. Texture is the whole decision here: a heavy sunscreen clogs pores and sends you back to step one, which is why a lightweight formula that layers without pilling is the one that actually gets worn.
rows.whyZh: 防晒卖给油痘肌的时候，通常被说成是保护痘印不变深，这个说法把它讲小了。紫外线在皮肤里产生活性氧，而正是这些活性氧把你皮脂中的角鲨烯氧化成「补」那一步讲的致粉刺产物。所以这一步不只是守住成果，它同时切断了上游的一个源头。这里唯一要决定的是肤感：厚重的防晒本身堵毛孔，那就又回到第一步了，所以能真正被涂上脸的，是那支轻盈、能叠涂而不搓泥的。

rows.why: Water-oil balance is the part oily skin gets backwards. Dehydrated skin does not produce less oil, it produces more, because the barrier reads dryness as damage. Hydration and oil control are the same project, not opposites. Overnight is when to do it: skin repair peaks while you sleep, so a leave-on mask is working with the window rather than against the day. The correcting serum is for the stage after, when the acne is handled and what is left is the marks, which are pigment rather than scars and will respond given enough weeks.
rows.whyZh: 水油平衡是油性皮肤最容易搞反的一环。缺水的皮肤不会少出油，而是会出更多油，因为屏障把干燥读成了损伤。补水和控油是同一个工程，不是对立面。而做这件事的时间是夜里：皮肤修复在睡眠中达到峰值，所以免洗的睡眠面膜是顺着这个修复窗口在做事，而不是跟白天硬碰硬。焕颜精华留给下一个阶段，痘控制住了、只剩痘印的时候，那是色素沉着而不是疤痕，给够周数它是会退的。

rows.why: Sleep is the free half of this plan, and the mechanism is more specific than people assume. Sebaceous cells carry receptors for corticotropin-releasing hormone, the stress signal. CRH does two things when it binds: it raises sebum output, and it activates the enzyme that converts precursors into active androgens, which raises sebum again. Skin sampled from acne-involved areas shows markedly stronger CRH receptor expression than clear skin on the same person. That is the mechanism behind breaking out after a bad week. Neither of these replaces going to bed earlier; they only help you land that step.
rows.whyZh: 睡眠是这套方案里免费的那一半，而它的机制比多数人以为的要具体。皮脂腺细胞上带有促肾上腺皮质激素释放激素（CRH，也就是压力信号）的受体。CRH结合上去之后做两件事：提高皮脂分泌，并激活把前体转化为活性雄激素的那个酶，于是皮脂再一次上升。取自痘痘部位的皮肤样本，其CRH受体表达明显强于同一个人身上没长痘的皮肤。这就是压力大的一周之后爆痘的机制。这两样都不能替代早睡，它们只是帮你把早睡这一步落地。

hormone.overview: Cyclical breakouts along the jaw, premenstrual mood shifts and cycle-linked fatigue follow a monthly rhythm rather than a daily one. That rhythm is the clue. The liver is where used hormones are cleared, minerals are lost and reset every month, and cortisol competes for the same raw materials. Judge any change over three cycles, not three weeks.
hormone.overviewZh: 下颌线周期性长痘、经前情绪波动、跟着周期走的疲劳，遵循的是月节律而不是日节律。这个节律本身就是线索：用过的激素在肝里清掉，矿物质每个月流失一次再重来，而皮质醇跟性激素抢的是同一批原料。看效果要看三个周期，不是三周。

rows.why: Used oestrogen has to be deactivated by the liver before it can leave the body. When liver capacity falls behind, hormones back up in the system, and what you see is the same few jawline spots before every period, along with mood swings and tenderness. So the first step in cyclical acne is not on the face, it is at the liver. It also explains why a topical can flatten one round and the same spot returns next month.
rows.whyZh: 用过的雌激素是经肝脏灭活之后才能排出的。肝的处理能力一旦跟不上，激素就堆在系统里，表现出来就是经前下颌线那几颗痘、情绪波动和胀痛。所以周期性痘痘的第一步不在脸上，在肝。这也解释了为什么外用能压住一次，下个月同一个位置又会回来。

rows.why: Chasteberry has the longest research history of any botanical used for cycle comfort. One usage point trips most people up: it is taken continuously through the month, not only on the difficult days, because the rhythm being supported is monthly rather than daily. By the same logic, judge it over three cycles, not three weeks.
rows.whyZh: 圣洁莓是周期类植物成分里研究历史最长的一味。用法上有一个关键点很多人做错：它要整月连续吃，而不是难受那几天才吃。因为你要支持的是一个月节律，不是一个日节律。同理，看效果要看三个周期，而不是三周。

rows.why: A woman's monthly cycle carries out a batch of magnesium and iron, so the mineral deficit reopens every month rather than being filled once. Calcium and magnesium also maintain neuromuscular excitability, which maps directly onto cramping and premenstrual tension. This is the step least worth skipping in a cycle protocol.
rows.whyZh: 女性每个月的生理周期都会带走一批镁和铁。这意味着女性的矿物质缺口是每月重新出现的，不是补一次就完事。而钙镁同时维持神经肌肉兴奋性，这直接对应经期绞痛和经前的紧绷感。所以这一步是周期方案里最不该省的一步。

rows.why: B vitamins are water-soluble and cannot be stored, clearing in roughly 24 hours, so they have to be taken daily. On the cycle line specifically, B6 is involved in neurotransmitter synthesis and is the link most often cited for premenstrual mood shifts, while B2 maintains sebaceous gland and follicle function, which connects straight back to jawline breakouts. One bottle covers both lines.
rows.whyZh: B 族是水溶性的，体内存不住，基本 24 小时清空，所以它必须每天补。对周期这条线而言，B6 参与神经递质合成，是经前情绪波动最常被提到的一个环节；而 B2 维护皮脂腺与毛囊功能，直接接回下颌线那几颗痘。一瓶盖两条线。

rows.why: Iron is the other mineral carried out every month, which is why high iron is nearly impossible in menstruating women and fairly common in men. The same protocol should not be prioritised the same way for both. One caution: iron should not be supplemented blind. Check haemoglobin and ferritin on a blood panel first.
rows.whyZh: 铁是另一个每月被带走的矿物质。这也是为什么女性铁超标几乎不可能，而男性反而常见偏高，同一套方案，男女优先级本来就不一样。要注意的是：铁不该盲补，先看体检里的血红蛋白和铁蛋白。

rows.why: Adaptogens are not sedatives; they moderate the cortisol response. Cortisol and the sex hormones share a synthesis pathway, and sustained pressure pulls capacity onto the cortisol side. That is why the months a cycle is most disrupted are usually also the most exhausting months. It sits in the Sustain stage because it addresses background load, not the symptom in front of you.
rows.whyZh: 适应原不是镇静剂，它调节的是皮质醇反应。而皮质醇和性激素共用一条合成原料链，长期高压会把这条链拿走。这就是为什么周期乱得最厉害的那几个月，往往也是最累的那几个月。放在「养」这一步，是因为它要解决的是背景类压力，不是当下症状。

eczema.overview: Skin is a backup detox route. It opens because the main route, the gut and then the liver, is blocked. That single idea sets the whole order: clear the main route first, rebuild the lipid barrier from the inside, and only then work on the surface. Creams relieve and then it comes back precisely because they treat the exit rather than the pressure.
eczema.overviewZh: 皮肤是排毒的备用通道，它被迫开启，是因为主通道（先肠道、再肝）堵了。这一个判断决定了整个顺序：先疏通主通道，再从内部把脂质屏障建起来，最后才处理表面。药膏能缓解、停了又复发，正是因为它处理的是出口，不是压力本身。

rows.why: Skin is a backup detox route, and it opens because the main route is blocked. So the first step with stubborn eczema is not the skin: rebuild the flora with probiotics and give fibre to carry things out. Probiotics without fibre is hiring staff and not feeding them. Working on the skin first is closing the backup exit while leaving the pressure unchanged.
rows.whyZh: 皮肤是排毒的备用通道。通道被迫开启，是因为主通道堵了。所以顽固湿疹的第一步不是从皮肤开始，而是先用益生菌重建菌群、用纤维把东西带走。只补菌不给纤维，等于招了人不给粮。反过来先在皮肤上使劲，等于一边堵备用出口一边不减压。

rows.why: The gut is the first route and the liver is the second. When the toxin load runs high, the portion the liver cannot process is what gets pushed out through the skin. It is also why eczema so often flares during stretches of heavy socialising, late nights and alcohol, which is exactly when the liver is busiest.
rows.whyZh: 肠道是第一道，肝是第二道。体内毒素负荷超标时，肝处理不完的那部分才会转而从皮肤走。这也是为什么很多人的湿疹在应酬多、熬夜多、饮酒多的那段时间集中发作，那正好是肝最忙的时候。

rows.why: The skin barrier is built from lipids, and the modern diet is heavily skewed toward omega-6. Adding omega-3 is not one more nutrient, it is pulling the fatty-acid ratio back. Once the ratio is right the barrier steadies and the skin's reaction to irritants slows down. For anyone who rarely eats oily fish, this gap is close to certain.
rows.whyZh: 皮肤屏障是由脂质构成的，而现代饮食严重偏向 Omega-6。补足 Omega-3 不是多一种营养，而是在把脂肪酸的比例拉回来。比例对了，屏障才稳，皮肤对刺激的反应才会缓下来。很少吃深海鱼的人，这个缺口几乎必然存在。

rows.why: The barrier-first approach means moisturising daily when the skin looks fine, not only when it flares. Waiting for a flare means always fighting the fire instead of preventing it. One detail people miss: the bigger variable is not the lotion, it is the body wash. A wash that cleans too aggressively strips a layer of barrier every day, and no lotion fully replaces that.
rows.whyZh: 屏障优先的做法是：皮肤看起来好的时候也每天润肤，而不是只在起疹时才润。等起疹才处理，就永远在救火而不是防火。另一个常被忽略的细节：变量最大的不是身体乳，是沐浴露，清洁力过强的沐浴露每天把屏障剥掉一层，再好的身体乳也补不回来。

metabolic.overview: Insulin is the signal that tells cells to take sugar out of the blood. In the pattern most adults over forty are in, the pancreas is still sending it, often more than ever. The cells have stopped answering. What makes them stop is fat in the wrong place: not the fat on your arms, which is fairly harmless, but the fat packed around the organs and inside the liver. That fat drains straight into the liver through the portal vein, pushes it to keep producing glucose when it should have stopped, and holds the whole system in low-grade inflammation. This is why someone only slightly overweight can have worse numbers than someone much heavier, and why waist measurement tells you more than weight does. Everything below sits alongside whatever your doctor has you on, never instead of it. The four steps run in order: flatten what arrives, change how the meal behaves, supply the raw materials, and hold the rhythm that the whole thing runs on.
metabolic.overviewZh: 胰岛素是通知细胞把糖从血里搬走的信号。四十岁以上多数人所处的状态是：胰腺还在发这个信号，往往比以前发得更多，但细胞不再应答。让它们不应答的，是长错位置的脂肪，不是手臂上那些相对无害的皮下脂肪，而是包在内脏周围、囤在肝里的那部分。这部分脂肪经门静脉直接引流进肝脏，逼着肝在该停止产糖的时候继续产糖，并把整个系统按在一层低度炎症里。这解释了为什么一个只是略微超重的人，指标可能比一个重得多的人更差，也解释了为什么腰围比体重能告诉你更多。下面所有内容都是与医生给你的方案并行，永远不是替代它。四步按顺序走：压平进来的量，改变一餐的行为方式，把原料供上，守住整件事赖以运转的节律。

rows.why: The second load is free, and it is the order you eat in. In crossover trials, eating protein and vegetables before the rice produced a measurably lower glucose excursion than the same meal eaten in the reverse order. Same plate, same calories, same person, different curve. This is the single cheapest thing on this page and the one to give someone first, because it costs nothing, it proves to them that the mechanism is real, and a person who has seen one thing work will try the next one.
rows.whyZh: 第二个负担是免费的，就是你吃东西的顺序。在交叉对照试验里，先吃蛋白质和蔬菜、后吃米饭，血糖曲线的波动明显低于同一餐反过来吃。同一盘菜、同样的热量、同一个人，曲线不一样。这是整页里最便宜的一件事，也是应该第一个交给别人的那件事，因为它不花钱、能让对方亲眼确认这个机理是真的，而一个见过一件事奏效的人，才会愿意试下一件。

rows.why: The first load is the size of the glucose spike after each meal, and you can flatten it without removing a single food. White kidney bean extract slows the enzyme that breaks starch into sugar, so part of a starch-heavy plate passes through instead of arriving all at once. Viscous fibre does the same job by a different route: it thickens what is in the stomach so the whole meal empties more slowly. This matters more than a diet plan for one reason. Nobody in a family that has eaten tortillas and rice for three generations is going to stop, and a plan that requires them to stop will be abandoned in a week. A plan that flattens the curve on the food they already eat can actually be kept.
rows.whyZh: 第一个负担是每餐之后血糖峰值的高度，而这个高度可以在不删掉任何一种食物的前提下压平。白芸豆提取物抑制把淀粉分解成糖的那个酶，让一部分淀粉直接通过，而不是一次性全涌进来。黏性纤维用另一条路做同一件事：它让胃里的东西变稠，整餐排空得更慢。这件事比一份食谱更重要，理由只有一个：一个三代人都在吃玉米饼和米饭的家庭，不会真的戒掉，而任何要求他们戒掉的方案，一周之内就会被放弃。能压平曲线又不动他们本来饮食的方案，才是能坚持下去的那个。

rows.why: The third load is the liver, and it is the organ this whole area turns on. Visceral fat drains directly into the liver through the portal vein, delivering fatty acids and inflammatory signals to it before they reach the rest of the body. A liver carrying its own fat responds poorly to insulin and keeps producing glucose when it should have stopped. This is also the mechanism behind something people find confusing: someone can be only slightly overweight and still have the metabolic picture of someone much heavier, because the fat is in the liver rather than under the skin.
rows.whyZh: 第三个负担在肝，而整个领域其实都是围着这个器官转的。内脏脂肪经门静脉直接引流进肝脏，把脂肪酸和炎症信号先送到肝，再送到全身其他地方。一个自己也囤着脂肪的肝，对胰岛素反应变差，该停止产糖的时候还在产糖。这也解释了一件让很多人困惑的事：有人只是略微超重，代谢指标却像一个重得多的人，因为脂肪长在肝里，而不在皮下。

rows.why: This stage is about changing what a meal does, and breakfast is where the leverage is. A carbohydrate-only breakfast sets the pattern for the whole day: it spikes, it crashes, and the crash is what makes the mid-morning craving feel like willpower failing when it is actually blood sugar. Replacing that one meal with protein is the highest-return single change in this area. There is a second reason it matters here specifically. When people lose weight, a meaningful share of what they lose is muscle, and muscle is the tissue that disposes of most of your blood glucose. Lose it and you come out of the diet metabolically worse than you went in.
rows.whyZh: 这一步管的是改变一餐的行为方式，而杠杆最大的地方是早餐。一顿只有碳水的早餐会给一整天定下节奏：血糖冲上去、掉下来，而那个下坠正是上午十点那种馋，感觉像是意志力不够，其实是血糖。把这一餐换成蛋白质，是整个领域里回报最高的单一改变。在这里它还有第二层意义：人在减重时掉的有相当一部分是肌肉，而肌肉正是处理你大部分血糖的组织。掉了肌肉，减完这一轮，代谢比开始前更差。

rows.why: The gut sits in this stage rather than the first one because for metabolism its job is conversion, not clearance. The bacteria in your colon ferment the fibre you send them and produce short-chain fatty acids, which is one of the ways fibre affects blood sugar beyond simply slowing the meal down. Postbiotics are those bacterial products supplied directly, so the benefit does not depend on whether the strains survive the journey. If someone is only going to add one thing here, fibre first and bacteria second: feeding the population you already have is cheaper than importing a new one.
rows.whyZh: 肠道放在这一步而不是第一步，是因为对代谢而言，它的职责是转化，不是清除。结肠里的菌把你送进去的纤维发酵成短链脂肪酸，这是纤维影响血糖的另一条路径，不只是把一餐变慢那么简单。后生元是把这些菌产物直接给到，所以效果不取决于菌株能不能活着走完这段路。如果只加一样，先纤维后菌：喂饱你本来就有的菌群，比引进一批新的便宜。

rows.why: Of everything on this page, magnesium has the strongest evidence and the least marketing behind it. Pooling twenty-five prospective studies covering more than 630,000 people, higher dietary magnesium intake tracked with roughly 17% lower risk of type 2 diabetes, dose-dependently: each extra 100mg a day was associated with a further 8 to 13% reduction. The label matters here too. This is 200mg delivered as bisglycinate chelate, hydroxide and malate rather than the cheap oxide most shelf products use, which is the difference between a dose you absorb and a dose that mostly reaches the toilet. Note what the evidence is and is not: an association across large populations, not a promise about your numbers.
rows.whyZh: 这一页上的所有东西里，镁的证据最强，而它背后的营销最少。汇总二十五项前瞻性研究、超过六十三万人，膳食镁摄入较高的人群，2型糖尿病风险约低 17%，而且呈剂量依赖：每天每多 100 毫克，风险再降 8% 到 13%。标签在这里也重要。这是 200 毫克，来自甘氨酸螯合镁、氢氧化镁和苹果酸镁，而不是货架上多数产品用的廉价氧化镁，这个区别决定了它是一份你吸收得进去的剂量，还是一份基本进了马桶的剂量。但要看清证据是什么、不是什么：这是大人群里的相关性，不是对你个人指标的承诺。

rows.why: A broad multivitamin is here for an unglamorous reason: the nutrients that matter for glucose handling are spread across many of them, and picking them off one at a time costs more than covering the whole floor at once. Chromium is the one people ask about, and the honest answer is that it is involved in how cells respond to insulin but the trial evidence is mixed and much of it is low quality, so treat it as a reasonable inclusion rather than the reason to buy. If the budget only stretches to one supplement in this whole area, this is a defensible choice, because it covers a wide floor rather than betting everything on one nutrient.
rows.whyZh: 综合营养素放在这里，理由并不花哨：与血糖处理相关的营养素分散在很多种里，一个一个单买，比一次性把底盘铺满更贵。铬是大家最常问的那个，诚实的回答是：它确实参与细胞对胰岛素的反应，但临床试验结果不一致，其中不少质量偏低，所以把它当成一个合理的配料，而不是购买的理由。如果整个领域的预算只够买一样，这是一个说得过去的选择，因为它铺的是一个宽的底盘，而不是把赌注压在单一营养素上。

rows.why: Insulin resistance runs on a background of low-grade inflammation, and visceral fat is an active source of it rather than an inert store. Omega-3 works on that background rather than on glucose directly, which is why you should not expect it to move a reading next week. The gap is almost always about ratio rather than absence: modern eating carries plenty of omega-6 and very little omega-3, and the balance between them sets the inflammatory tone.
rows.whyZh: 胰岛素抵抗是建立在一层低度炎症的背景之上的，而内脏脂肪不是惰性的储存仓，它本身就是炎症的活跃来源。Omega-3 作用在这层背景上，而不是直接作用于血糖，所以不要指望它下周就把某个读数改掉。这个缺口几乎总是比例问题而不是有无问题：现代饮食里 Omega-6 很多、Omega-3 很少，而炎症的基调由两者的比例决定。

rows.why: Two supporting lines for people who have gone past the basics. Plant pigment families are how the body sources several antioxidants it cannot make, and almost nobody eats across all the colour groups in a week. B vitamins are coenzymes in energy metabolism and get consumed faster on a high-carbohydrate diet, which describes most people arriving at this page. The 120-count works out under thirty cents a day, which makes it one of the easiest additions to justify to a household watching every dollar.
rows.whyZh: 两条辅助线，给已经做完基础项的人。植物色素家族是身体获取多种自身无法合成的抗氧化物的来源，而几乎没有人能在一周内把所有色系吃全。B族是能量代谢里的辅酶，在高碳水饮食下消耗得更快，而这正好描述了大多数会看到这一页的人。120粒装算下来每天不到三毛钱，对于一个每一块钱都要算的家庭，这是最容易说得通的一笔添加。

rows.why: Sleep is the lever most people skip and it acts directly on this problem. Short sleep raises cortisol, cortisol raises blood glucose, and it pushes appetite specifically toward the foods that make tomorrow's numbers worse. So a bad week of sleep is not a separate topic from blood sugar, it sits upstream of it. Neither of these replaces going to bed earlier; they help someone land that step. Say that out loud, because a person who thinks a capsule substitutes for sleep will be disappointed and stop trusting the rest.
rows.whyZh: 睡眠是多数人跳过的那根杠杆，而它直接作用在这个问题上。睡眠不足抬高皮质醇，皮质醇抬高血糖，同时把食欲专门推向那些让明天指标更难看的食物。所以睡不好的一周不是血糖之外的话题，它在血糖的上游。这两样都不能替代早睡，它们只是帮人把早睡这一步落地。这句话要说出口，因为一个以为吃胶囊可以代替睡觉的人，最后会失望，然后连带着不再相信其余部分。

metabolic.overview_es: La insulina es la señal que le dice a las células que saquen el azúcar de la sangre. En el patrón en el que está la mayoría de los adultos de más de cuarenta, el páncreas sigue mandándola, a menudo más que nunca. Las células han dejado de responder. Lo que hace que dejen de responder es la grasa en el lugar equivocado: no la de los brazos, que es bastante inofensiva, sino la que se empaqueta alrededor de los órganos y dentro del hígado. Esa grasa drena directo al hígado por la vena porta, lo empuja a seguir produciendo glucosa cuando debería haber parado, y mantiene todo el sistema en inflamación de bajo grado. Por eso alguien con solo un poco de sobrepeso puede tener peores números que alguien mucho más pesado, y por eso la medida de la cintura dice más que el peso. Todo lo de abajo va junto a lo que tu médico te haya indicado, nunca en su lugar. Los cuatro pasos van en orden: aplana lo que llega, cambia cómo se comporta la comida, aporta la materia prima, y sostén el ritmo del que depende todo lo demás.

weight.overview: Two people lose the same ten pounds. One loses mostly fat and keeps it off. The other loses a third of it as muscle, and muscle is the tissue that burns energy at rest, so they finish the diet lighter and worse at staying light. Then they regain, and the weight that comes back is fat. That is the loop, and it is why the number on the scale is a poor guide to whether something is working. The four steps below are built around composition rather than the number: make the meals you eat more filling so the deficit is bearable, get enough protein that your body has no reason to break down muscle, cover the nutrient gaps that open up whenever you eat less, and protect what you built, because the hard part was never the losing.
weight.overviewZh: 两个人减掉同样的十斤。一个减掉的主要是脂肪，而且守住了；另一个有三分之一减掉的是肌肉，而肌肉恰恰是静息状态下消耗能量的组织，于是这一轮减完，人更轻了，但更不容易维持轻。然后反弹，涨回来的是脂肪。这就是那个循环，也是为什么体重秤上的数字并不能说明一件事有没有奏效。下面四步围绕的是身体成分而不是数字：让你吃的每一餐更顶饱，好让热量缺口撑得下去；把蛋白质吃够，让身体没有理由去拆肌肉；补上少吃之后必然出现的营养缺口；最后守住你建起来的东西，因为难的从来不是减掉。
weight.overview_es: Dos personas pierden los mismos cinco kilos. Una pierde sobre todo grasa y los mantiene. La otra pierde un tercio en forma de músculo, y el músculo es el tejido que quema energía en reposo, así que termina la dieta más ligera y peor preparada para seguir ligera. Después recupera, y lo que vuelve es grasa. Ese es el bucle, y por eso el número de la báscula es una mala guía para saber si algo está funcionando. Los cuatro pasos de abajo giran en torno a la composición y no al número: haz que las comidas que ya haces llenen más para que el déficit sea soportable, come suficiente proteína para que tu cuerpo no tenga motivo para deshacer músculo, cubre los huecos de nutrientes que se abren siempre que comes menos, y protege lo que construiste, porque la parte difícil nunca fue bajarlo.

rows.why: Start by making the same food fill you up more, because a deficit you cannot tolerate is a deficit you will not keep. Viscous fibre thickens what is in the stomach and slows how fast it empties, which is why a meal with fibre in it stops feeling like a meal you finished twenty minutes ago. This is the cheapest lever in the whole area and it works on food you already buy. Most adults get roughly half the fibre they need, so for most people this is closing a real gap rather than adding something exotic.
rows.whyZh: 先让同样的食物更顶饱，因为一个你忍受不了的热量缺口，就是一个你守不住的缺口。黏性纤维让胃里的东西变稠、排空变慢，这就是为什么一顿有纤维的饭，不会二十分钟后就像没吃过。这是整个领域最便宜的杠杆，而且作用在你本来就在买的食物上。大多数成年人的纤维摄入只有需要量的一半左右，所以对多数人来说，这是在补一个真实的缺口，而不是加一样新奇的东西。

rows.why: Then replace the one meal you consistently lose control of. For most people that is not dinner, it is breakfast skipped and then a mid-afternoon collapse. Replacing a single meal with something of known size removes a decision instead of adding a rule, and decisions are what run out by 4pm. The test for a bar is the first three ingredients: a candy bar with protein added leads with sugar, a whole-food bar leads with nuts, fruit or oats. That difference decides whether it helps or just moves the problem.
rows.whyZh: 然后替换掉你固定会失控的那一餐。对多数人来说不是晚餐，是早餐没吃、然后下午彻底垮掉。把一餐换成分量已知的东西，是减少一个决定，而不是增加一条规矩，而到下午四点先用完的，正是决定力。判断一根能量棒看前三位配料：加了蛋白质的糖果棒第一位是糖，全食物棒第一位是坚果、水果或燕麦。这个区别决定了它是帮你，还是只是把问题挪了个位置。

rows.why: The third lever is the starch-heavy meal you are not going to give up. The label is 500mg of white kidney bean extract, which inhibits alpha-amylase, the enzyme that breaks starch into absorbable sugar. Some of that plate passes through undigested instead of arriving as glucose. Be clear about what this is: a tool for specific meals, taken before them, not a daily supplement and not permission to eat more. It belongs here because a plan that requires someone to abandon the food their family eats will be the first thing abandoned.
rows.whyZh: 第三根杠杆是那顿你不打算放弃的、淀粉很重的饭。标签上是 500 毫克白芸豆提取物，它抑制的是α-淀粉酶，也就是把淀粉分解成可吸收糖分的那个酶。那一盘里有一部分会不经消化直接通过，而不是变成葡萄糖进来。要说清楚它是什么：针对特定几餐、饭前吃的工具，不是每天必补的营养品，更不是多吃的许可证。它放在这里，是因为一个要求人放弃家里那口饭的方案，会最先被放弃。

rows.why: Read this label before deciding what it is. 150mg of GreenSelect Phytosome, which is green tea catechins bound to phosphatidylcholine, delivering only 20mg of EGCG. That number looks too small until you see the point: ordinary green tea extract trials use 200 to 800mg of EGCG, and the phospholipid complex exists to raise absorption so a fraction of the dose does the work. That matters for safety as much as effect, because the liver signals reported with green tea extract come from the high-dose end. In a controlled trial adding it to a low-calorie diet, the supplemented group lost substantially more over 90 days than diet alone, though that trial was open-label rather than blinded, so treat the direction as more trustworthy than the size.
rows.whyZh: 先看标签再决定它是什么。150 毫克 GreenSelect Phytosome，也就是与磷脂酰胆碱结合的绿茶儿茶素，实际提供的 EGCG 只有 20 毫克。这个数字看起来小得离谱，直到你看懂它的用意：普通绿茶提取物的试验用的是 200 到 800 毫克 EGCG，而磷脂复合物的存在就是为了提高吸收率，让零头的剂量做同样的事。这一点对安全性和对效果同样重要，因为绿茶提取物报告出的肝脏信号，来自的正是高剂量那一端。在一项把它加进低热量饮食的对照试验里，加了这一项的组在 90 天里减掉的明显更多，但那项试验是开放标签而非双盲，所以方向比幅度更值得相信。

rows.why: This is the step that decides what you lose. In controlled trials at matched weight loss, the higher-protein group lost about 1.5kg of lean mass while the normal-protein group lost about 2.8kg. Same scale reading, nearly twice the muscle gone in one group. Protein also blunts the drop in fullness that comes with eating less, so it works on adherence at the same time. If you only do one thing on this page, do this one, and put it at breakfast, which is the meal most people currently eat as pure carbohydrate.
rows.whyZh: 这一步决定你减掉的是什么。在体重下降幅度相当的对照试验里，高蛋白组瘦体重减少约 1.5 公斤，普通蛋白组约 2.8 公斤。秤上的数字一样，其中一组掉的肌肉几乎是另一组的两倍。蛋白质同时还能缓解少吃带来的饱腹感下降，所以它顺带解决了坚持度的问题。如果这一页你只做一件事，就做这件，并且放在早餐，因为那正是多数人目前当作纯碳水在吃的一餐。

rows.why: Fibre only pays off if you have the bacteria to ferment it. They turn it into short-chain fatty acids, which is one of the routes by which fibre affects appetite signalling rather than just physically filling you. Order matters and saves money: feed the population you already have before importing a new one, so fibre first, bacteria second.
rows.whyZh: 纤维要有菌来发酵才划算。菌把它变成短链脂肪酸，这是纤维影响食欲信号的路径之一，而不只是物理上把你填满。顺序有讲究，也省钱：先喂饱你本来就有的菌群，再考虑引进新的，所以先纤维、后菌。

rows.why: Eating less means eating fewer nutrients, and that is the part diet advice never mentions. Cut 500 calories a day and you cut roughly a fifth of everything that came with them. The symptoms people blame on dieting, the flatness, the cold hands, the hair in the drain, are frequently that gap rather than the calorie deficit itself. Covering a wide floor cheaply matters more here than any single nutrient, which is the argument for a broad multi over buying six bottles.
rows.whyZh: 少吃意味着摄入的营养素也少了，而这一点，减肥建议从来不提。每天少吃 500 大卡，你同时也少掉了随之而来的大约五分之一的一切。人们归咎于节食的那些症状，没精神、手脚冰凉、地漏里的头发，很多时候是这个缺口造成的，而不是热量缺口本身。在这里，把底盘便宜地铺宽，比任何单一营养素都重要，这也是选综合而不是买六瓶的理由。

rows.why: Two specific gaps worth closing. B vitamins are the coenzymes that let you turn food into usable energy, they are water-soluble so they clear in about a day, and they get used up faster under stress, which describes anyone in a deficit. Omega-3 works on the inflammatory background that body fat actively maintains rather than on weight directly, so judge it over months. Between them the 120-count B complex runs under thirty cents a day, which makes it the easiest thing here to keep.
rows.whyZh: 两个值得补上的具体缺口。B族是把食物转成可用能量的辅酶，它是水溶性的，大约一天就清空，而且在压力下消耗更快，而处在热量缺口里的人正是这种状态。Omega-3 作用的是脂肪组织本身在维持的那层炎症背景，而不是直接作用于体重，所以要按月来看。两者之中，120粒装的B族每天不到三毛钱，是这里最容易坚持下去的一样。

rows.why: This is the most under-rated finding in the whole area. In a controlled trial where people ate the same restricted diet, those whose sleep was cut short lost 55% less of their weight as fat. Same calories, same weight on the scale, but far more of it came out of muscle. Short sleep also raises ghrelin and pushes appetite specifically toward sweet food, so it attacks the plan from both ends. Neither of these replaces going to bed earlier. They help someone land that step, and saying so plainly is what keeps them trusting the rest of the page.
rows.whyZh: 这是整个领域里最被低估的一个发现。在一项对照试验里，人们吃同样的限制饮食，而睡眠被削短的那组，减掉的重量中脂肪的比例低了 55%。同样的热量、秤上同样的数字，但其中相当大一部分是从肌肉里出来的。睡眠不足同时抬高饥饿素，并把食欲专门推向甜食，等于从两头同时拆你的计划。这两样都不能替代早睡，它们只是帮人把早睡这一步落地。把这句话说明白，才是让人继续相信这一页其余内容的原因。

rows.why: Protein gives your body the material to keep muscle. Resistance training gives it the reason. Without the signal that the muscle is being used, the body treats it as expensive tissue it can afford to lose, and in a deficit it will. Two sessions a week is enough to change the answer, and this is the step that decides whether you end up smaller and stronger or just smaller.
rows.whyZh: 蛋白质给身体保住肌肉的材料，力量训练给它保住肌肉的理由。如果没有「这块肌肉还在被使用」这个信号，身体就会把它当成一块养不起的昂贵组织，而在热量缺口下，它真的会拆掉。每周两次就足以改变这个答案，而这一步决定了你最后是变小并且变强，还是只是变小。

rows.why: Regain is the normal outcome, not the exception, and the plan rarely fails at dinner. It fails in the gap between meals when there is nothing on hand and something convenient is. Keeping one acceptable option in the bag, the car and the desk drawer is a boring intervention that outperforms most of what gets sold as motivation.
rows.whyZh: 反弹是常态而不是例外，而计划很少是在晚餐时崩的。它崩在两餐之间那个空档：手边什么都没有，而方便的东西正好在。在包里、车里、办公桌抽屉里各放一样能接受的东西，是个很无聊的干预，但它的效果好过大多数以「动力」为名卖出去的东西。

sleep.overview: The stress system is meant to stand down at night. When cortisol stays high into the evening, the brain stays on watch, and you get the tired-but-wired pattern: flat all afternoon, alert at midnight. Lost sleep then feeds the loop; in one study, six short nights raised evening cortisol in healthy young men. The calming signals are built from nutrients, magnesium and the B vitamins among them, and stress uses those up faster. So the steps run in order: remove what keeps the alarm on, calm the stress system and reset the clock, refill the raw materials, then hold a rhythm long enough to stick. Loud snoring, pauses in breathing, or trouble sleeping most nights for three months need a doctor, not a supplement.
sleep.overviewZh: 压力系统本来应该在夜里下班。如果皮质醇到晚上还降不下来，大脑就一直处在值班状态，于是出现那种又累又亢奋的样子：下午整个人没电，半夜却精神十足。睡不够又反过来加重这个循环；一项研究里，健康的年轻男性连续六晚睡眠不足后，晚间皮质醇明显升高。让人平静下来的信号，是用营养素造出来的，镁和B族都在其中，而压力会加快它们的消耗。所以四步的顺序是：先拿掉让警报一直响的东西，再让压力系统平静、把生物钟调回来，然后补上原料，最后把节奏坚持到它稳住。如果打鼾很响、睡眠中有呼吸暂停，或者连续三个月大多数晚上都睡不好，需要的是医生，不是补充剂。

rows.why: Start by removing what keeps the alarm on. Caffeine lingers for hours: in one study, a dose taken six hours before bed cut measured sleep by more than an hour, and people did not notice. Screen light in bed delays the night signal, and a heavy late dinner or evening drinks leave the liver working when the body should be winding down. The teaching behind this plan routes trouble falling asleep through the liver first. Last coffee before 2 pm, a lighter dinner three hours before bed, and the phone out of the bedroom.
rows.whyZh: 先拿掉让警报一直响的东西。咖啡因会在体内停留好几个小时：一项研究里，睡前六小时摄入的咖啡因，让实测睡眠少了一个多小时，而当事人自己毫无察觉。躺在床上看屏幕，光线会推迟身体的「天黑了」信号；晚饭吃得太晚太重，或者晚上喝酒，肝脏在该休息的时候还在加班。这套方案的思路是，入睡困难先从肝入手。咖啡最晚下午两点前，晚饭清淡些、离睡觉三小时，手机不进卧室。

rows.why: Ashwagandha works on the stress system itself rather than knocking you out. Across five trials it gave a small but real improvement in sleep, larger at 600 mg a day or more, over eight weeks or longer, and in people with insomnia. It works over weeks, not tonight. Take it with the evening meal and judge it at eight weeks. Skip it if you are pregnant or breastfeeding or have thyroid, autoimmune or liver disease, and stop and see a doctor if you notice dark urine or yellowing skin.
rows.whyZh: 南非醉茄作用在压力系统本身，而不是把你「放倒」。汇总五个试验来看，它对睡眠有小而确实的改善，每天600毫克以上、持续八周以上、以及本身有失眠的人，效果更明显。它是按周起效的，不是今晚吃了今晚就好。跟晚饭一起吃，八周后再判断。怀孕、哺乳，或者有甲状腺、自身免疫、肝脏方面的问题，不要吃；如果出现尿色变深或皮肤发黄，立刻停用并去看医生。

rows.why: The gut and the brain signal each other in both directions, and stress rarely leaves digestion alone. One strain in this probiotic lowered perceived stress over five weeks and improved sleep recovery in highly stressed adults. A larger trial in students missed its main anxiety goal, though sleep disturbance was lower. So the evidence is mixed and the effect modest: worth trying if stress shows up in your stomach as well as your sleep. One capsule with food at the same time each day, judged after five to eight weeks.
rows.whyZh: 肠道和大脑之间是双向传递信号的，压力很少会放过消化。这款益生菌里的一株菌，在五周内降低了受试者自评的压力，并改善了高压人群的睡眠恢复。但另一项规模更大的学生试验，没有达到主要的焦虑指标，只是睡眠干扰有所减少。所以证据有好有坏，效果也不大：如果你的压力同时体现在胃和睡眠上，值得一试。每天同一时间随餐一粒，五到八周后再判断。

rows.why: Both of these contain 3 mg of melatonin, and melatonin is a clock signal, not a sleeping pill: it tells the body that night has started. On average it helps people fall asleep about seven minutes faster, which is why it suits a shifted clock, jet lag or getting back to a fixed wake time better than long-term insomnia. Use it for occasional nights, 30 to 60 minutes before bed, and do not drive or drink afterwards. Keep it away from children, and ask a doctor first if you are pregnant, breastfeeding or on blood thinners.
rows.whyZh: 这两款都含3毫克褪黑素，而褪黑素是一个时钟信号，不是安眠药：它告诉身体「天黑了」。平均来看，它能让人入睡快大约七分钟，所以它更适合生物钟被打乱的情况，比如倒时差、或者要把起床时间调回来，而不是长期失眠。只在偶尔需要的晚上用，睡前30到60分钟，吃完不要开车、不要喝酒。放在孩子拿不到的地方；怀孕、哺乳或在服用抗凝药的人，先问医生。

rows.why: Stress raises how much magnesium the body loses, and low magnesium makes the stress response more reactive, so the two feed each other. About half of US adults get less than they need from food. In small trials, older adults with insomnia fell asleep about 17 minutes faster on magnesium, though the evidence is low quality. Take it with dinner, food first where you can, and keep supplemental magnesium within 350 mg a day; loose stools are the first sign of too much. Choose calcium magnesium D if you eat little dairy.
rows.whyZh: 压力会增加镁的流失，而缺镁又让压力反应更敏感，两者互相加重。大约一半的美国成年人从食物里吃不够镁。小型试验里，有失眠的老年人补镁后入睡快了大约17分钟，不过证据质量不高。跟晚饭一起吃，能从食物里补的先从食物补，补充剂来源的镁每天不超过350毫克；大便变稀是过量的第一个信号。如果平时很少吃奶制品，选钙镁D片。

rows.why: The brain builds its calming signals, GABA and serotonin, with enzymes that depend on vitamin B6, and the B vitamins as a group keep nerves supplied. They are water-soluble, the body stores them for hours rather than days, and stress, heavy drinking and refined-carb eating use them faster. Take them daily with food. If they feel energising, move them to dinner rather than skipping them, and avoid stacking several products that each contain B6, because B6 has a daily upper limit of 100 mg.
rows.whyZh: 大脑用来让自己平静下来的信号，GABA和血清素，要靠依赖维生素B6的酶来合成，而整个B族一起负责给神经供给原料。B族是水溶性的，身体只能存几个小时，而压力、经常喝酒和精致碳水饮食，都会加快它的消耗。每天随餐吃。如果吃了觉得太提神，就改到晚饭吃，而不是不吃；另外别同时吃好几种都含B6的产品，因为B6每天有100毫克的上限。

rows.why: The rhythm this plan follows anchors the evening between about 7:30 and 8:40 pm: B vitamins and liver support at the same time every night, for six months, because liver cells take roughly 180 days to renew. There is no mainstream research on the timing itself, so its value is as a cue. The same act at the same hour starts the wind-down two hours before bed, and after it the lights go down. Judge it at six months, not after a week.
rows.whyZh: 这套方案的节律，把晚上锚定在大约7点半到8点40之间：每晚同一时间吃B族和护肝，坚持六个月，因为肝细胞大约180天更新一轮。主流研究并没有专门验证这个时间点，所以它的价值在于当一个信号：每天同一时间做同一件事，提前两小时开启放松，做完之后把灯调暗。按六个月来判断，而不是一周。

rows.why: Keep the same wake time seven days a week; a fixed schedule is part of the approach doctors use first for chronic insomnia. Sleep runs in cycles of about 90 minutes, and waking in the middle of deep sleep is what makes a morning feel awful, so count back from your alarm in 90-minute steps: a 7 am alarm means aiming to be asleep around 11:30 pm. If you miss it, wait for the next cycle rather than lying awake. The sleep and stress bundle puts the evening routine in one box.
rows.whyZh: 一周七天保持同一个起床时间；固定作息是医生治疗慢性失眠时首选方法的一部分。睡眠以大约90分钟为一个周期，在深睡中途被叫醒，就是早上特别难受的原因，所以从闹钟往回按90分钟倒推：早上7点起床，就争取11点半左右睡着。错过了，就等下一个周期，而不是躺着硬熬。睡眠减压方案把晚间的这一套放在了一个盒子里。

energy.overview: Energy is something your cells make all day, out of food, and three things usually get in the way. The day runs on refined carbs and sugar, which lift you for an hour and then drop you. Sleep runs short, and the debt adds up quietly while caffeine hides it. And the raw materials that turn food into energy, protein, the B vitamins and iron, run low without any hunger signal to warn you. The four steps take them in that order: stop the swings, stop the leaks, supply the materials, then keep the daily rhythm that holds it. If the tiredness has lasted more than a few weeks, or comes with weight loss, breathlessness, very heavy periods or low mood, see a doctor first.
energy.overviewZh: 精力是细胞每天用食物一点点造出来的，通常有三件事在拖后腿。一天靠精致碳水和糖撑着，提神一小时，然后掉下来。睡眠不够，睡眠债悄悄累积，咖啡把它盖住了。把食物变成能量的原料，蛋白质、B族和铁，缺了也不会有饥饿感提醒你。下面四步就按这个顺序来：先止住起伏，再堵住漏洞，然后把原料补上，最后用每天固定的节奏把成果守住。如果累了已经好几周，或者同时有体重下降、气短、经量很多、情绪低落，请先去看医生。

rows.why: The first thing to take off is the swing. A meal or snack that is mostly refined carbs lifts you briefly, and a pooled analysis of 31 studies found carbohydrates actually raise fatigue within 30 minutes and lower alertness within the hour. The early-afternoon dip is partly your body clock, but a carb-heavy lunch deepens it. You do not have to give up carbs, you have to stop eating them alone. Swap the 3 pm pastry or sweet drink for something with protein and fibre, and a glass of water.
rows.whyZh: 第一步先卸掉的是那个起伏。一顿以精致碳水为主的饭或零食，只能让你精神一小会儿；一项汇总了31个研究的分析发现，碳水吃下去30分钟内疲劳感反而上升，一小时内警觉度下降。午后那一阵犯困，一部分是生物钟本身，但一顿高碳水的午饭会让它更深。你不需要戒掉碳水，要做的是别让碳水单独出现。把下午三点的点心或甜饮料，换成有蛋白质和纤维的东西，再配一杯水。

rows.why: The second load sits in the gut, and it matters most when the tiredness comes with bloating, irregular stools or a mostly takeout diet. The teaching behind this plan puts clearing before replenishing: poorly digested food and a gut out of balance keep using up the very nutrients step three will supply, and chronic fatigue sits on the same checklist as bloating and constipation. Direct evidence for gut products treating fatigue is thin, so treat this as getting the order right, not as an energy supplement.
rows.whyZh: 第二个负担在肠道。如果疲劳同时伴随腹胀、排便不规律，或者三餐大多靠外卖，这一步最要紧。这套方案的逻辑是先清后补：消化不完全、菌群失衡，会不断消耗第三步要补进去的营养素，而慢性疲劳和腹胀、便秘本来就在同一张肠道信号清单上。直接用肠道产品来治疲劳，主流研究的证据并不多，所以把它当作把顺序做对，而不是提神产品。

rows.why: Sleep debt is the leak most people underestimate. In a controlled study, two weeks of six hours a night left people as impaired as two nights with no sleep at all, while they reported feeling only slightly sleepy. Caffeine does not repay that debt, it hides it, and about a third of US adults sleep under seven hours. Fix the wake time first, the same seven days a week, then aim for seven hours or more. Magnesium in the evening supports the wind-down; low magnesium intake is common, and tiredness is one of its early signs.
rows.whyZh: 睡眠债是最多人低估的漏洞。一项对照研究里，连续两周每晚只睡六小时的人，表现跌到相当于整整两晚没睡，而他们自己只觉得有点困。咖啡还不了这笔债，只是把它盖住；大约三分之一的美国成年人每晚睡不到七小时。先把起床时间固定下来，一周七天一样，再争取睡够七小时以上。晚上补镁可以帮身体放松下来；镁摄入不足很常见，而疲劳正是它最早的信号之一。

rows.why: What you eat only counts once it is absorbed, and iron is where that quietly fails. Black tea drunk with a meal cut absorption of plant iron by 79 to 94 percent in one study, and coffee has a smaller but real effect. Vitamin C does the opposite: it turns iron into the form the gut takes up most easily. So keep coffee and tea at least an hour away from meals, and take vitamin C alongside iron-rich food or an iron tablet. It costs nothing, and for anyone who relies on plant iron it is a big fix.
rows.whyZh: 吃进去的东西要吸收了才算数，而铁恰恰是悄悄出问题的地方。一项研究里，吃饭时喝红茶，让植物来源的铁吸收下降了79%到94%，咖啡也有影响，只是小一些。维生素C的作用正好相反，它把铁转成肠道最容易吸收的形式。所以咖啡和茶至少离开饭点一小时，吃富含铁的食物或铁片时，配上维生素C。这个修正不花钱，对主要靠植物获取铁的人来说，效果不小。

rows.why: Energy is made by enzymes, and enzymes are made of protein. A practical target is about 1.2 g of protein per kilogram of body weight a day, so 72 g for someone who weighs 60 kg, with roughly a third of it at breakfast, because breakfast sets the energy for the day and dinner goes to repair. A breakfast of toast, cereal or congee supplies a fraction of that. If yours looks like that, one shake closes most of the gap. Work out your own number, then look at what your first meal actually contains.
rows.whyZh: 能量是酶造出来的，而酶是蛋白质做的。一个实用的目标是每天每公斤体重约1.2克蛋白质，体重60公斤就是72克，其中大约三分之一放在早餐，因为早餐供应一整天的精力，晚餐负责修复。一顿吐司、麦片或白粥的早餐，只能提供其中一小部分。如果你的早餐是这样，一杯蛋白奶昔就能补上大部分缺口。先算出你自己的数字，再看看你的第一餐到底吃进了多少。

rows.why: The B vitamins are the coenzymes that turn carbohydrate, fat and protein into usable energy. B1 is needed to burn carbohydrate, the brain's main fuel. B2, B3 and B5 work inside the energy cycle itself, and B12 and folate build the red cells that carry oxygen. They are water-soluble, the body keeps little in reserve, and refined grains lose most of theirs in milling. The benefit is clearest where intake has been short: irregular meals, regular drinking, or years on metformin or acid reducers, which lower B12 absorption. Take them with food.
rows.whyZh: B族维生素是把碳水、脂肪、蛋白质转化成可用能量的辅酶。B1负责燃烧碳水，而碳水是大脑的主要燃料；B2、B3、B5就在能量循环内部工作；B12和叶酸负责制造运送氧气的红细胞。它们是水溶性的，身体几乎存不住，而精米白面在加工中丢掉了大部分。最能看出效果的，是本来就摄入不足的人：三餐不规律、经常喝酒，或者长期服用二甲双胍、抑酸药的人，这些药会降低B12的吸收。随餐吃。

rows.why: Iron is the best-evidenced lever in this area, and the reason many people are told their labs look normal. A standard blood count can be fine while iron stores are low. In a trial of 198 menstruating women with low ferritin but no anaemia, twelve weeks of iron cut fatigue by 48 percent, against 29 percent on placebo. That is a specific group: women with heavy periods, vegetarians and frequent blood donors. Ask for a ferritin test before taking iron long term, because iron can build up, and recheck after about three months.
rows.whyZh: 铁是这个领域证据最扎实的一个杠杆，也是很多人被告知「化验单正常」却依然很累的原因。血常规可能完全正常，而体内的铁储备已经偏低。一项试验里，198位有月经、铁蛋白偏低但没有贫血的女性，补铁十二周后疲劳下降了48%，安慰剂组是29%。这是特定的人群：经量偏多的女性、素食者、经常献血的人。长期补铁之前先查铁蛋白，因为铁会在体内累积，大约三个月后再复查。

rows.why: Energy metabolism uses more than B vitamins and iron: magnesium, zinc and vitamin C all take part, and a shortfall in any one of them slows the whole line. A multivitamin is the base that covers several at once, which is why it sits under the targeted products rather than replacing them. Regular exercise raises the demand rather than lowering it, so people who train hard and eat irregularly are the most likely to run short. One base taken every day does more than five bottles taken now and then.
rows.whyZh: 能量代谢用到的不只是B族和铁，镁、锌、维生素C都参与其中，任何一样不足，整条流水线都会变慢。综合营养素是一次覆盖好几样的底座，所以它放在针对性产品的下面，而不是取代它们。规律运动不会减少需求，反而会增加，所以训练多、吃饭又不规律的人，最容易缺。一个底座每天吃，比五个瓶子有一顿没一顿地吃更有用。

rows.why: The morning is where energy is won or lost for the day. The breakfast this plan is built around covers seven things in one meal: protein, fibre, probiotics, good fats, plant foods, vitamins and minerals, eaten between 7 and 9 am. It does the first three steps at once, which is why keeping it is the fourth. The foundation bundle puts the multivitamin, protein and omega-3 in a single order. Treat it like brushing your teeth: the same breakfast every weekday, not a new plan every Monday.
rows.whyZh: 一天的精力，早上就决定了一大半。这套方案围绕的营养早餐，一餐覆盖七类：优质蛋白、膳食纤维、益生菌、优质脂肪、蔬果植物营养、维生素和矿物质，在早上7到9点吃。它一餐就完成了前三步，所以守住它就是第四步。基础营养方案把综合营养素、蛋白粉和深海鱼油放在一单里。把它当成刷牙一样：每个工作日同一份早餐，而不是每周一换一个新计划。

rows.why: The evening half of the rhythm comes from the tradition this plan follows: B vitamins and liver support taken together between about 7:30 and 8:40 pm, every evening, for six months. The reasoning is that the liver processes everything the day brought in, and its cells take roughly 180 days to renew, so it is judged over months, not days. There is no mainstream research on the timing itself, so hold it as a routine that anchors the evening rather than as a claim. If falling asleep is part of the problem, start here too.
rows.whyZh: 节奏的另一半在晚上，来自这套方案所依据的调理传统：每天晚上大约7点半到8点40之间，B族和护肝一起吃，坚持六个月。道理是肝脏要处理一整天带进来的所有东西，而肝细胞大约180天更新一轮，所以要按月看效果，而不是按天。主流研究并没有专门验证这个时间点，所以把它当作固定晚间节奏的习惯，而不是一项功效声明。如果入睡困难也是问题之一，同样从这里开始。

rows.why: CoQ10 sits inside the energy machinery of every cell, and the body makes less of it with age. A pooled analysis of 13 trials found it reduced fatigue compared with placebo, with most of the effect in people who were already unwell, so its place is narrow: people past their mid-forties, or anyone whose tiredness comes with a long-term condition. Talk to your doctor first if you take a statin or a blood thinner. It is an add-on for the right person, not a first step for everyone.
rows.whyZh: 辅酶Q10位于每个细胞的能量机器内部，身体自己合成的量会随年龄下降。一项汇总了13个试验的分析发现，它比安慰剂更能减轻疲劳，但效果大多出现在本身已有健康问题的人身上，所以它的位置很窄：四十五岁以上，或者疲劳伴随长期慢性问题的人。如果你在吃他汀类或抗凝药，先问医生。它是给合适的人的补充，不是每个人的第一步。

digestion.overview: Constipation and loose stools look like opposite problems, but most of the time they are the same one: stool with the wrong amount of water in it. Fibre is what holds that water, and most adults eat about 16 g a day against the 25 to 38 g they need. Water helps once the fibre is there. The bacteria then ferment that fibre into acids that keep the bowel moving, and the whole system runs on a daily rhythm that is strongest in the morning. The steps follow that order: bulk and water, then the bacteria, then the raw materials, then the rhythm. Blood in the stool, black stool, weight loss you cannot explain, or a new change in habit that lasts, especially after 50, need a doctor first.
digestion.overviewZh: 便秘和稀便看起来是相反的两个问题，其实大多数时候是同一件事：大便里的水分不对。能把水分留住的是膳食纤维，而大多数成年人每天只吃到16克左右，需要的是25到38克。有了纤维，喝水才真正有用。接着，肠道细菌把纤维发酵成酸性物质，推动肠道蠕动；整个系统跟着一天的节律走，早上最活跃。下面四步就按这个顺序：先有体积和水分，再是菌群，然后是原料，最后是节律。如果大便带血或发黑、体重不明原因下降，或者排便习惯出现新的、持续的变化，尤其是50岁以后，请先去看医生。

rows.why: Start with fibre, because it decides how much water the stool can hold, and that is what makes it too hard or too loose. US adults average about 16 g a day against 25 g for women and 38 g for men. In trials, adding more than 10 g a day for at least four weeks is what changed frequency. Food carries most of the bulk: vegetables first at each meal, then beans, oats and whole grains. The powder tops up the gap. Raise fibre by about 5 g a week, and drink a full glass of water with each serving.
rows.whyZh: 从纤维开始，因为它决定大便能留住多少水分，而太干或太稀，说到底就是水分的问题。美国成年人平均每天只吃到约16克纤维，女性需要25克，男性38克。临床试验里，真正改变排便频率的，是每天额外增加10克以上、持续至少四周。大部分的量应该来自食物：每餐先吃蔬菜，再加豆类、燕麦和全谷物，纤维粉用来补上差的那一截。每周增加大约5克，别一下加太多，每一份都配一整杯水。

rows.why: Fibre is also food, and the bacteria that eat it turn it into acids that keep the bowel moving. That makes probiotics the second lever, not the first. The strain matters more than the count: one strain in this product, B. lactis HN019, cut whole-gut transit time from 49 hours to 21 in a two-week trial, while other strains in other studies did nothing. Across trials the average gain is modest, about one extra bowel movement a week. Take it daily with food, alongside the fibre it lives on, and judge it after four weeks.
rows.whyZh: 纤维同时也是食物，吃它的细菌会把它发酵成酸性物质，推动肠道蠕动。所以益生菌是第二个杠杆，而不是第一个。菌株比菌数更重要：这款产品里的一株乳双歧杆菌HN019，在一项两周的试验里，把食物通过整个肠道的时间从49小时缩短到21小时；而其他研究里的另一些菌株，完全没有效果。综合所有试验，平均改善并不夸张，大约每周多一次排便。每天随餐吃，和它赖以生存的纤维一起，四周后再判断效果。

rows.why: Enzymes answer a different problem: the heavy, bloated feeling after a big meal, not how often you go. The stomach's protein-digesting enzymes decline with age, and food that sits undigested is uncomfortable. The evidence for enzyme supplements is honestly thin, with small trials showing less bloating after single meals, so use them where that symptom is clear rather than every day by default. The 6-in-1 drink combines fibre, enzymes and fermented greens if you would rather take one thing than three.
rows.whyZh: 消化酶解决的是另一个问题：大餐之后那种胀、那种沉，而不是排便次数。胃里分解蛋白质的酶会随年龄减少，没消化完的食物停在那里，人就不舒服。老实说，消化酶补充剂的证据并不多，小型试验显示单顿饭后的腹胀有所减轻，所以只在这个症状明确的时候用，而不是默认每天吃。如果不想同时吃三样，六合一饮品把纤维、酶和发酵蔬菜放进了一杯。

rows.why: Magnesium draws water into the bowel and relaxes smooth muscle, and about half of US adults get less than they need from food. The form here is gentle and well absorbed, so it covers that gap rather than acting as a laxative; laxative magnesium is a different product, used at doses above the safe daily limit for supplements. Take it in the evening with water and keep supplemental magnesium within 350 mg a day. With kidney disease, or if you already use a magnesium laxative, ask your doctor first.
rows.whyZh: 镁会把水分带进肠道，同时放松肠道的平滑肌，而大约一半的美国成年人从食物里吃不够镁。这里用的是温和、好吸收的形式，作用是补上这个缺口，而不是当泻药用；泻药级别的镁是另一类产品，剂量超过了补充剂的每日安全上限。晚上随水服用，补充剂来源的镁每天不超过350毫克。如果有肾脏问题，或者已经在用含镁的通便药，先问医生。

rows.why: The gut lining renews itself every few days, and it is built from protein, as are the digestive enzymes that break food down. A breakfast of white bread or congee brings little of either, and heavy, low-fibre meat meals work against step one. A plant protein shake at breakfast replaces the refined carbs without adding to the load. Keep fibre on the plate alongside it, because protein does not do fibre's job.
rows.whyZh: 肠道内壁每隔几天就更新一次，它的原料是蛋白质，负责分解食物的消化酶也一样。白面包或白粥的早餐，两样都给不了多少；而油腻、少纤维的大鱼大肉，又在拖第一步的后腿。早餐一杯植物蛋白奶昔，替掉精致碳水，又不增加负担。同时盘子里的纤维不能少，因为蛋白质替代不了纤维的作用。

rows.why: The bowel runs on a clock. Its strongest contractions come in bursts on waking and after meals, and the reflex that triggers them is strongest after breakfast. The rhythm this plan follows puts warm water first thing, then breakfast between 7 and 9 am, which lands on exactly that window. Give yourself ten unhurried minutes after breakfast, do not ignore the urge, and keep the same time on weekends. The 30-day program adds structure for the first month, roughly how long fibre and probiotics take to show.
rows.whyZh: 肠道是有时钟的。它最强的推进性收缩，集中出现在刚醒来和饭后，而触发它的那个反射，早餐后最强。这套方案的节律是：起床先喝温水，然后在早上7到9点吃早餐，正好落在这个窗口上。早餐后给自己留十分钟，不慌不忙，有便意别忍，周末也保持同一个时间。30天计划在第一个月帮你把结构搭起来，而这差不多正是纤维和益生菌开始见效所需的时间。

rows.why: For some people the pattern is clear: loose stools arrive with deadlines, travel or conflict, because the gut and the brain signal each other in both directions. This probiotic uses strains chosen for that gut-brain link. There is no bowel-habit trial for this exact product, so it is an option for that specific pattern rather than a default. Use it in place of the standard probiotic, not on top of it. Loose stools that last more than a few days, or come with fever, are a question for a doctor.
rows.whyZh: 有些人的规律很明显：一到截止日期、出差或者吵架，就开始拉肚子，因为肠道和大脑是双向传递信号的。这款益生菌选的是针对这条肠脑通路的菌株。这个具体产品目前没有针对排便习惯的试验，所以它是给这种特定情况的选项，而不是默认配置。用它替换普通益生菌，而不是叠加着吃。如果稀便持续好几天，或者伴随发烧，那是该问医生的问题。

immunity.overview: Your immune system is not a muscle you can boost. It is a tissue that rebuilds itself constantly, and it struggles when it runs short or gets overloaded. Much of it lines the gut, so that is where the load comes off first. Sleep is the lifestyle lever with the hardest numbers behind it. Then comes steady supply: protein, vitamin C and vitamin D every day, because the benefit in trials came from regular intake, not from reacting once a cold starts. Nothing here prevents infection. A fever lasting more than three days, trouble breathing, or infections that keep coming back need a doctor.
immunity.overviewZh: 免疫系统不是一块可以「练大」的肌肉。它是一个时刻都在自我更新的组织，一旦原料短缺或者负担过重，就会力不从心。免疫系统有很大一部分分布在肠道，所以负担要先从这里卸下来。在所有生活习惯里，睡眠背后的数据最硬。接下来是稳定供应：每天的蛋白质、维生素C和维生素D，因为试验里的好处来自规律摄入，而不是感冒开始了才临时补。这里的任何内容都不能预防感染。发烧超过三天、呼吸困难，或者感染反反复复，请去看医生。

rows.why: Much of the immune system lines the gut, and a gut out of balance keeps it busy with trouble at home. That is why the load comes off here first. In a Cochrane review of 24 trials, people taking probiotics were about a quarter less likely to get an upper respiratory infection (low certainty) and about 40 percent less likely to get three or more. Probiotics add bacteria and fibre feeds them, and most adults eat about half the fibre they need. Take one daily with cool water, not hot, and judge it after four weeks.
rows.whyZh: 免疫系统有很大一部分分布在肠道，肠道一旦失衡，免疫系统就忙着处理「家里」的麻烦。所以负担先从这里卸。一篇汇总了24个试验的Cochrane综述发现，吃益生菌的人发生上呼吸道感染的比例低了大约四分之一（证据确定性较低），一年感染三次以上的比例低了约40%。益生菌负责把好菌补进去，纤维负责喂养它们，而大多数成年人只吃到所需纤维的一半左右。每天一次，用温凉水送服，别用热水，四周后再判断。

rows.why: The simplest way to lower what the immune system has to deal with is to let less in. Community handwashing programs cut respiratory illnesses such as colds by 16 to 21 percent. The catch is that people cut washing short once their hands crack, and cracked skin is a broken barrier of its own, so a soap that does not strip matters more than it sounds. Twenty seconds on getting home, before eating, and after the school run.
rows.whyZh: 减轻免疫系统负担最简单的办法，是少放点东西进来。社区洗手推广能让感冒这类呼吸道疾病减少16%到21%。问题在于，手一干裂，人就会洗得马马虎虎，而干裂的皮肤本身就是一道破了的屏障，所以一块不伤手的洗手液，比听起来更重要。到家、吃饭前、接完孩子，各洗二十秒。

rows.why: Air is an optional step, and an expensive one. Fine particles irritate the lining of the nose and airways, a HEPA filter traps 99.97 percent of particles at the size hardest to catch, and portable units cut indoor fine particles by roughly half to four fifths. That matters in homes with allergies, wildfire smoke, a busy road outside or pets. There is no evidence that a purifier prevents colds, so buy one for the air, not for the virus. If you do, start with the bedroom, door closed, running all night.
rows.whyZh: 空气是可选的一步，也是昂贵的一步。细颗粒物会刺激鼻腔和呼吸道黏膜，HEPA滤网对最难拦截的那个粒径能拦住99.97%，便携式净化器能让室内细颗粒物下降大约一半到八成。这对家里有人过敏、遇上山火烟雾、住在大马路边或者养宠物的家庭有意义。没有证据表明净化器能预防感冒，所以买它是为了空气，不是为了病毒。如果要买，先放卧室，关上门，整夜开着。

rows.why: Sleep is the lever with the hardest numbers. In a study that measured people's sleep and then exposed them to a cold virus, those sleeping under six hours were about four times more likely to catch the cold than those sleeping over seven. In another, short sleepers were far more likely to be left unprotected after a hepatitis B vaccine. The products here only help the wind-down; the habit does the work. Protect seven hours and a steady bedtime, most of all in the week before travel or a vaccine.
rows.whyZh: 睡眠是数据最硬的那个杠杆。一项研究先测量受试者的真实睡眠，再让他们接触感冒病毒，结果每晚睡不到六小时的人，感冒的几率大约是睡七小时以上的人的四倍。另一项研究里，睡得少的人打完乙肝疫苗后，没能产生保护的比例高得多。这里的产品只是帮身体放松下来，真正起作用的是习惯。守住七小时和固定的上床时间，出差或打疫苗前的那一周尤其要守住。

rows.why: Inflammation is how the immune system protects you, but fried food, smoke, alcohol and heavily processed meals keep a low level of it running all day, and that background noise competes with the real job. Plant compounds from colourful fruit and vegetables help keep that background down. There is no strong evidence that capsules change how often you get sick, so treat these as a floor under your diet on busy weeks, not a replacement for eating five colours. Take them with a meal.
rows.whyZh: 炎症本来是免疫系统保护你的方式，但油炸食品、烟、酒和深度加工的饭菜，会让低度的炎症整天开着，这种背景噪音会跟真正的任务抢资源。五颜六色的蔬果里的植物营养素，有助于把这层背景压下来。没有强有力的证据表明胶囊能改变你生病的频率，所以把它们当作忙碌那几周饮食的保底，而不是用来代替每天吃够五种颜色。随餐吃。

rows.why: Vitamin C and D have the clearest evidence here, and both work only when taken daily. In a Cochrane review of 29 trials, regular vitamin C did not prevent colds in most people, but it shortened them by about 8 percent in adults and 14 percent in children; starting it after a cold began showed no consistent benefit. Vitamin D reduced respiratory infections most in people who were low, and with daily or weekly doses, not large occasional ones. Ask your doctor for a vitamin D test if you spend most of the year indoors.
rows.whyZh: 维生素C和D是这里证据最清楚的两样，而且都只有每天吃才有用。一篇汇总了29个试验的Cochrane综述发现，规律补充维生素C并不能让大多数人不感冒，但能让成人的感冒缩短约8%，儿童缩短约14%；等感冒开始了才吃，没有一致的效果。维生素D对本来就缺乏的人减少呼吸道感染最明显，而且要每天或每周补，偶尔来一次大剂量没用。如果你一年大部分时间待在室内，请医生帮你查一下维生素D水平。

rows.why: Antibodies, white blood cells and the signals they send are all made of protein, and the front-line cells are replaced within days, so the supply has to arrive every day. Running short on protein is well known to weaken immune responses. A practical target is about 1.2 g per kilogram of body weight a day, and the meal that most often has almost none is breakfast. If yours is toast or congee, one scoop, 21 g, closes a large part of the gap.
rows.whyZh: 抗体、白细胞，以及它们之间传递的信号，全都是蛋白质做的，而冲在一线的免疫细胞几天就换一批，所以原料必须每天送到。蛋白质不足会削弱免疫反应，这一点早有定论。一个实用的目标是每天每公斤体重约1.2克蛋白质，而最常几乎没有蛋白质的那一餐，就是早餐。如果你的早餐是吐司或白粥，一勺21克的蛋白粉，就能补上很大一块缺口。

rows.why: Zinc, selenium and iron all take part in immune cells doing their job, and the margins are narrow in both directions: too little slows them, and too much zinc over months causes a copper shortfall. A multivitamin is the base that covers the everyday amounts. The zinc tablet is for short, high-stress stretches, not all year, and the review evidence for zinc preventing colds is weak. Check the labels so that zinc from all sources stays under 40 mg a day.
rows.whyZh: 锌、硒、铁都参与免疫细胞的工作，而且两头的余地都很窄：太少，细胞干活慢；锌吃太多、吃太久，又会导致铜不足。综合营养素是覆盖日常用量的底座。锌片只用在压力特别大的短期阶段，不是全年吃，而且综述里锌预防感冒的证据很弱。看一下标签，确保所有来源加起来，锌每天不超过40毫克。

rows.why: The benefit in the vitamin C and D trials came from steady daily intake, not from reacting when a cold starts, so the real task is not letting the routine lapse, above all in the week you are run down. The foundation bundle puts the multivitamin, protein and omega-3 in a single order. Put it on a monthly auto-order, take it with the same meal every day, and judge it over a season, not a week.
rows.whyZh: 维生素C和D试验里的好处，来自每天稳定地吃，而不是感冒来了才反应，所以真正的任务是别让这个习惯断掉，尤其是在你最累的那一周。基础营养方案把综合营养素、蛋白粉和深海鱼油放在一单里。设成每月自动下单，每天跟同一顿饭一起吃，按一个季节来看效果，而不是一周。

rows.why: Some weeks carry more exposure: travel, the peak of flu season, or the fortnight after a child brings something home. Echinacea is meant for short runs like these, not for all year, and the honest evidence is modest: pooled trials suggest a 10 to 20 percent lower risk, with no clear result in any single trial. Sanitiser is for when there is no soap, not instead of it. Use these for the stretch, then stop.
rows.whyZh: 有些时候接触的病菌就是更多：出差、流感高峰，或者孩子从学校带了东西回家之后的那两周。紫锥菊就是为这种短期阶段设计的，不是全年吃，而且老实说证据有限：合并分析显示风险可能降低10%到20%，但没有任何一个单独的试验得出明确结果。免洗洗手液是在没有肥皂的时候用的，不是代替洗手。这段时间用，过了就停。

rows.why: For children, the format is the strategy: drops for toddlers who cannot chew, a chewable after that, and a gummy for the ones who refuse both. In the Cochrane review, regular vitamin C shortened children's colds by about 14 percent. Give it at the same time every morning, and store gummies where a child cannot help themselves, because they look like sweets. Any fever in a baby under three months, or a fever that lasts more than three days, needs a doctor.
rows.whyZh: 给孩子吃，形式就是策略：还不会嚼的幼儿用滴剂，会嚼了用咀嚼片，两样都不肯吃的就用软糖。Cochrane综述里，规律补充维生素C让儿童感冒缩短了约14%。每天早上固定时间吃，软糖放在孩子自己拿不到的地方，因为它们看起来就像糖果。三个月以下的婴儿只要发烧，或者任何孩子发烧超过三天，都要去看医生。

hair.overview: Hair grows in cycles, and most of the shedding people notice is a delayed reaction: a shock such as stress, a fever, surgery, childbirth or a crash diet pushes many hairs into their resting phase at once, and they fall out two to three months later. That shedding is usually temporary, because the roots are unharmed. The plan works in order. First take the load off the scalp and the strand: an oily, flaky scalp, harsh styling and heat. Then fix what quietly blocks supply: iron that is eaten but not absorbed, and stress that keeps the cycle disturbed. Then supply what hair is built from, protein first, iron where stores are low, and a broad base of vitamins and minerals without megadoses, because too much vitamin A or selenium can itself cause hair loss. Finally keep a daily care and breakfast routine long enough to judge it, which for hair means months. If hair comes out in patches or clumps, the scalp is sore, red or scarred, the part is widening, or the shedding comes with tiredness, weight change, feeling cold or heavy periods, see a doctor first.
hair.overviewZh: 头发是按周期生长的，大部分人注意到的掉发，其实是延迟反应：一段压力、一次发烧、手术、生孩子或者节食，会让很多头发同时进入休止期，两三个月后才一起掉下来。毛根本身没有受损，所以这种掉发通常是暂时的。下面四步按顺序来。先卸掉头皮和发丝的负担：油腻起屑的头皮、伤发的造型和高温。再处理悄悄卡住供应的地方：吃进去却没吸收的铁，还有让生长周期一直乱着的压力。然后把头发的原料补上，蛋白质第一，铁储备低的补铁，再加一个维生素矿物质的底座，但不要大剂量，因为维生素A或硒过量本身就会掉发。最后把每天的护理和早餐坚持下去，坚持到足够判断效果的时间，对头发来说，是按月算的。如果头发成片或一把一把地掉，头皮疼、发红或留疤，发缝越来越宽，或者掉发同时伴随乏力、体重变化、怕冷、经量很多，请先去看医生。

rows.why: Hair grows out of the scalp, so the scalp comes first. Flakes and itch on an oily scalp usually come from a yeast that lives on everyone's skin and feeds on oil; the mild form is dandruff, the stronger one seborrhoeic dermatitis. The American Academy of Dermatology's advice runs against instinct: an oily, flaky scalp needs washing more often, not less. Lather the dandruff shampoo into the scalp and leave it on for about five minutes, two or three times a week during a flare. Fine white flakes with a tight, dry scalp are a different problem and need gentler washing.
rows.whyZh: 头发长在头皮上，所以先顾头皮。油性头皮上的头皮屑和痒，多半来自一种人人皮肤上都有、靠油脂生存的酵母菌，轻的是头皮屑，重一点就是脂溢性皮炎。美国皮肤科学会的建议和很多人的直觉相反：头皮越油越起屑，越要勤洗，而不是少洗。去屑洗发水要揉在头皮上，停留五分钟左右再冲，发作期每周两到三次。如果是细小发白的屑、头皮又干又紧，那是另一种问题，反而要洗得温和一些。

rows.why: Not every hair in the drain came out at the root. Losing 50 to 100 hairs a day is normal, and much of the rest is breakage from bleach, colour, relaxers, daily heat and tight ponytails. A shed hair has a small white bulb at one end; a broken one does not. Tight styles worn for years can cause permanent loss at the hairline, so loosen them first. Anti-hair-fall care works on strand strength, and the tonic keeps care on the scalp itself. A widening part or thinning temples is usually inherited pattern loss, which no shampoo reverses; a dermatologist has proven treatments, best started early.
rows.whyZh: 下水口里的头发，不一定都是从根部掉的。每天掉50到100根是正常的，多出来的很多其实是断发：漂、染、拉直、天天用高温、马尾扎得太紧。一看就能分：掉下来的头发一头有个白色小球，断的没有。长年扎得太紧，发际线可能出现永久性脱发，所以先松一松。防脱系列针对的是发丝的强韧度，头皮精华让护理留在头皮上。如果是发缝越来越宽、两鬓变稀，多半是遗传性脱发，洗发水逆转不了，皮肤科有经过验证的治疗，越早开始越好。

rows.why: The teaching behind this plan puts clearing before replenishing, and it lists dull hair and brittle nails on the same checklist as bloating, constipation and irregular stools: signs, in its view, that a gut out of balance is using up or failing to absorb what the body is given. No mainstream trial shows gut products improve hair, so treat this step as getting the order right for people whose hair problems come with digestive ones, not as a hair treatment. The simple version is fibre stirred into water or coffee, plus a daily probiotic.
rows.whyZh: 这套方案的逻辑是先清后补。它把头发没光泽、指甲变脆，和腹胀、便秘、排便不规律放在同一张肠道信号清单上：在它看来，肠道失衡的时候，吃进去的营养要么被消耗掉，要么吸收不进去。主流研究里还没有试验证明肠道产品能改善头发，所以这一步适合头发问题同时伴随肠胃问题的人，是把顺序做对，不是治头发的产品。最简单的做法：纤维粉加进水或咖啡里，再加每天一份益生菌。

rows.why: Iron is where absorption quietly fails, and iron matters for hair. Black tea drunk with a meal cut absorption of plant iron by 79 to 94 percent in one study, and coffee has a smaller but real effect. Vitamin C does the opposite, turning iron into the form the gut takes up most easily, and a major review of vitamins in hair loss calls vitamin C intake crucial where hair loss comes with low iron. So keep tea and coffee at least an hour away from meals, and take vitamin C with iron-rich food or an iron tablet. It costs nothing and matters most for people who eat little red meat.
rows.whyZh: 铁最容易在吸收这一关悄悄出问题，而铁对头发很关键。一项研究里，吃饭时喝红茶，让植物来源的铁吸收下降了79%到94%，咖啡也有影响，只是小一些。维生素C正好相反，它把铁变成肠道最容易吸收的形式；一篇关于维生素矿物质与脱发的重要综述明确说，缺铁相关的脱发，维生素C的摄入非常关键。所以茶和咖啡离开饭点至少一小时，吃富含铁的食物或铁片时配上维生素C。这个做法不花钱，对很少吃红肉的人最有用。

rows.why: Stress is one of the most common triggers of the shedding people notice, and the timing hides it. A hard stretch, a fever or an operation pushes many hairs into their resting phase at once, and they fall out two to three months later, when the event already feels over. Once the trigger passes, the American Academy of Dermatology says, shedding stops and most people regain normal fullness within six to nine months. What helps is working on the stress: sleep, a wind-down routine, and ashwagandha, which lowered stress scores in trials of stressed adults. No trial has measured its effect on hair.
rows.whyZh: 压力是最常见的掉发诱因之一，而时间差让人很难联想到。一段高压期、一次发烧或手术，会让很多头发同时进入休止期，两三个月后才一起掉，那时你早觉得事情已经过去了。美国皮肤科学会指出，诱因过去以后，掉发会停下来，多数人在六到九个月内恢复原来的发量。要处理的是压力本身：睡眠、睡前放松的习惯，还有南非醉茄，在压力大的成年人中做过的试验里，它降低了压力评分。不过还没有试验直接测过它对头发的作用。

rows.why: Hair is keratin, a protein, made by some of the fastest-dividing cells in the body. When protein runs short, the body keeps it for organs and muscle and lets hair go, which is why crash and low-protein diets are a classic trigger for shedding a few months later, and why shedding is one of the most common complaints after weight-loss surgery. The teaching behind this plan uses 1.2 g of protein per kilogram of body weight a day, above the 0.8 g official minimum: 72 g for someone of 60 kg. One shake adds 21 g. If you are cutting calories, cut them slowly and keep the protein.
rows.whyZh: 头发是角蛋白，由全身分裂最快的一批细胞制造。蛋白质一不够，身体会先保器官和肌肉，头发排在最后，所以节食、低蛋白饮食几个月后开始掉发，是很典型的情况，减重手术后掉发也是最常见的困扰之一。这套方案用的标准是每天每公斤体重1.2克蛋白质，高于官方0.8克的最低量：60公斤就是72克。一杯蛋白粉能补21克。如果在控制热量，就慢慢减，蛋白质别减。

rows.why: Iron is the best-studied nutrient in shedding, and low stores can hide behind a normal blood count. Hair-loss studies define low iron with ferritin cut-offs anywhere from 15 to 70 micrograms per litre, some dermatologists aim above 40 when shedding persists, and most authors agree that iron deficiency with hair loss should be corrected. The people most likely to be short are women with heavy periods, new mothers, vegetarians and frequent blood donors. Ask for a ferritin test before taking iron long term, because iron builds up and too much is harmful, then recheck after about three months.
rows.whyZh: 铁是脱发研究里证据最多的营养素，而铁储备偏低，常常藏在正常的血常规后面。关于脱发的研究，判断缺铁用的铁蛋白标准从每升15到70微克不等，持续掉发时，有些皮肤科医生希望铁蛋白在40以上；多数学者都同意，缺铁又掉发，就应该把铁补上来。最容易缺的是经量多的女性、刚生完孩子的妈妈、素食者和常献血的人。长期补铁之前先查铁蛋白，因为铁会在体内累积，过量有害，大约三个月后再复查。

rows.why: The follicle also runs on zinc, the B vitamins and other micronutrients, and one study found zinc deficiency in about one in ten people with shedding. A multivitamin covers them at sensible doses. More is not better: vitamin A above 3,000 micrograms a day and selenium above 400 micrograms are known to cause hair loss themselves, and zinc above 40 mg drains copper. The teaching behind this plan prefers beta-carotene, which the body turns into vitamin A only as needed. It also links a greasy, flaky face and scalp to low B2 and B6, whose classic deficiency looks like that; the B complex covers both.
rows.whyZh: 毛囊干活还离不开锌、B族和其他微量营养素，一项研究发现，大约十分之一的掉发者缺锌。每天一份综合营养素，就能按合理的量把这些都覆盖到。这里不是越多越好：维生素A每天超过3000微克、硒超过400微克，本身就会导致掉发；锌超过40毫克还会消耗铜。这套方案偏好β-胡萝卜素，身体缺多少才转化多少维生素A。它还把脸上、头皮出油起屑和B2、B6不足联系在一起，这两种维生素缺乏的典型表现正是如此，B族正好把它们补上。

rows.why: Biotin is what most people buy for hair, and the honest picture is narrow. Real deficiency is uncommon, though one study found low levels in 38 percent of 541 women with shedding. A 2024 review found only three studies of biotin alone and called its marketing for hair loss in healthy people unsubstantiated. It also interferes with lab tests: the FDA has warned it can make a heart-attack test read falsely low, so tell your doctor and the lab you take it. Collagen has one small placebo-controlled trial: 44 women on 2.5 g of specific peptides a day for 16 weeks grew thicker strands.
rows.whyZh: 生物素是大家买来护发最多的成分，但实话说，它适用的范围很窄。真正缺乏的人不多，不过有一项研究在541位掉发女性里，发现38%生物素偏低。2024年的一篇综述只找到三项单用生物素的研究，结论是：向健康人宣传生物素防脱，缺乏依据。它还会干扰化验：美国FDA警告过，它可能让心梗检测的结果假性偏低，所以要告诉医生和化验室你在吃。胶原蛋白有一项小型安慰剂对照试验：44位女性每天2.5克特定胶原肽，16周后发丝变粗。

rows.why: Once hair leaves the scalp it is dead fibre. Nothing you eat repairs the length you already have; care protects it until new, better-fed hair grows through. The American Academy of Dermatology's routine is simple: shampoo the scalp rather than the lengths, and use conditioner after every shampoo, on the ends, where it adds shine and strength and cuts breakage. Pick the line by the problem: Intensive Repair for colour-treated, bleached or heat-styled hair, Smooth for dry or frizzy hair. Pat dry rather than rubbing, and turn the heat down.
rows.whyZh: 头发一离开头皮，就是没有生命的纤维。吃什么都修不回已经长出来的那一段，护理的作用是把它护住，等新长出来、营养更好的头发慢慢接上。美国皮肤科学会的做法很简单：洗发水洗头皮，不是洗发梢；每次洗完都用护发素，抹在发尾，能增加光泽和强韧度，减少断发。按问题选系列：染过、漂过、常用高温的选密集修护，干、毛躁的选柔润。用毛巾按干，不要来回搓，吹风机温度调低。

rows.why: Hair grows about a centimetre a month, and a follicle pushed into rest takes months to cycle back, so hair is judged in months, not weeks. The breakfast this plan is built around puts protein, good fats, vitamins and minerals into the first meal every day, eaten between 7 and 9 am, and the foundation bundle covers the multivitamin, protein and omega-3 in one order. On omega-3, one randomised six-month study of 120 women taking an omega-3, omega-6 and antioxidant blend found better hair density on photographs than in the comparison group. It was one study of a different formula, so hold it lightly.
rows.whyZh: 头发一个月大约长一厘米，被推进休止期的毛囊，要好几个月才能重新回到生长期，所以看头发要按月，不能按周。这套方案围绕的营养早餐，每天第一餐就把蛋白质、优质脂肪、维生素和矿物质吃进去，时间在早上7到9点；基础营养方案把综合营养素、蛋白粉和深海鱼油放在一单里。关于鱼油，一项为期六个月、120位女性参加的随机研究，服用含Omega-3、Omega-6和抗氧化剂的配方后，照片评估的发量比对照组好。但这只是一项研究，配方也不同，参考即可。

rhinitis.overview: Allergic rhinitis is the immune system treating harmless things, pollen, dust mites, pet dander, as threats and releasing histamine, which brings the sneezing, the runny or blocked nose and the itchy eyes. The biggest lever is exposure, so the plan clears first: the bedroom, the air, the pollen carried in on hair and clothes, and a salt-water nose rinse. Next it works on balance through the gut, where much of the immune system is trained, and through plant compounds. Then it replenishes vitamin D and the nutrients the lining of the nose uses to renew itself. The last step is timing and routine: start seasonal support about two weeks before your season and keep the bedroom habits going. None of this replaces the antihistamines or steroid nasal sprays a doctor recommends; guidelines rank steroid sprays as the most effective single treatment, and these steps sit alongside them. See a doctor first for wheezing, chest tightness or a night cough, facial pain or fever, or symptoms that do not respond to what you already use.
rhinitis.overviewZh: 过敏性鼻炎，是免疫系统把花粉、尘螨、宠物皮屑这些无害的东西当成威胁，释放出组胺，于是打喷嚏、流鼻涕或鼻塞、眼睛痒。最大的杠杆是接触量，所以方案先「清」：卧室、空气、跟着头发衣服带进门的花粉，再加上盐水洗鼻。接着通过肠道来「调」平衡，免疫系统很大一部分是在肠道里被训练的，再加上植物化合物。然后「补」上维生素D和鼻腔黏膜更新要用的营养素。最后一步是时机和习惯：在你的过敏季开始前两周左右启动，卧室的习惯一直保持。这些都不能替代医生建议的抗组胺药或激素喷鼻剂；指南把激素喷鼻剂列为单用效果最好的治疗，这里的步骤是配合它们一起用的。如果有喘鸣、胸闷或夜里咳嗽，脸颊疼或发烧，或者现在用的药不管用，请先去看医生。

rows.why: Start with the room you spend a third of your life in. Dust mites live in pillows, mattresses and bedding, and pet dander clings to everything, so the bedroom is where exposure piles up overnight. In a multicentre placebo-controlled trial in dust-mite-allergic adults, six weeks of HEPA purifiers cut bedroom fine particles by up to half and reduced the medication people needed, though symptom scores did not differ. Mite allergen is heavy and settles fast, so pair the purifier with a hot wash of the bedding every week. Keep the door shut and pets out.
rows.whyZh: 先从你一生三分之一时间待的地方开始。尘螨住在枕头、床垫和被褥里，宠物皮屑又什么都能粘上，所以卧室是一整晚过敏原越积越多的地方。一项多中心、有安慰剂对照的试验里，对尘螨过敏的成年人在家用了六周HEPA净化器，卧室细颗粒物最多降了一半，需要用的药也变少了，不过症状评分和对照组没有明显差别。尘螨过敏原比较重，落得快，所以净化器要配合每周高温洗床品。卧室门关上，宠物别进卧室。

rows.why: In pollen season the load comes in on the air, your hair and your clothes. Allergy groups advise keeping windows shut on high-pollen days, showering and changing when you get home, and washing out the nose. That last one has real support: a Cochrane review of 14 trials found saline rinses may ease symptoms in adults and children over up to three months, with rare, mild side effects. A pooled analysis of eight air-filter trials found a small drop in day and night symptoms. So close up, rinse off, and let a purifier sized for the living space handle the air.
rows.whyZh: 花粉季，过敏原是跟着空气、头发、衣服一起进门的。过敏专科的建议是：花粉浓度高的日子关好窗，回家先洗澡换衣服，再洗洗鼻子。洗鼻子这一条是有证据的：Cochrane汇总14项试验发现，生理盐水洗鼻在三个月内可能减轻成人和儿童的症状，副作用少而且轻。一项汇总八个空气过滤试验的分析也看到，白天和夜里的症状都有小幅下降。所以关窗、冲洗，再让一台适合客厅大小的净化器负责屋里的空气。
